profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Product, Platform, and Performance Systems | Unity/C#/Web | DevOps Analytics & Telemetry | CI/CD | Cross-Platform Development | Cloud Developer | Legacy System Modernization | Internal Tooling
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineering leader with more than 12 years of experience supporting energy, industrial, marketing, and entertainment sectors. Expertise includes cloud infrastructure; AI, LLM, MCP, and third-party API integration; analytics instrumentation; cross-platform systems; analytics instrumentation; workflow automation; telemetry pipelines; and content authoring tooling. Known for pairing strong product judgment with engineering rigor and driving high-impact optimization across performance, delivery, and cost.

• Reduced Azure infrastructure spend 47% in first month and 84% overall via service right-sizing, architecture cleanup, storage optimization, and SQL tuning
• Led profiling and optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, and batching; improved frame perf ~32%; met 72 FPS constraint to ensure polished end user experience
• Implemented CI/CD and blue-green deployments to replace ad hoc FTP-based releases; reduced deployment time by over 80%; increased safe release capacity from two (2) to 12 deployments per day
 
Software Architecture, Cloud / DevOps, Data-Driven Decision-Making, Performance Engineering CI/CD Pipelines Legacy System Modernization, Cross-Platform Development, Internal Tooling, Technical Product Translation.

I'm here to assist you on your projects, message me here on LinkedIn.
